source: UN Resident Coordinator Namibia - Cholera Outbreak Situation Report No. 2 (as of 21 Feb 2014)
processing_notes: Source states: 'Namibia has been experiencing an outbreak of cholera since Nov 2013, previously largely confined to northern regions. The situation in particularly hard-hit Kunene was said to have been brought under control on 20 January 2014. However, additional cases with some fatalities were recorded in Kunene, as well as Otjozondjupa and Oshana regions in the last week. [UN RC Situation Report No. 2, as of 21 Feb 2014; reproduced on OCHA map 375v02 of 24 Feb 2014]' - cholera confirmed present; no case count available.

source: ReliefWeb Namibia Cholera 2013-2014 Outbreak Disaster Page
processing_notes: Source states: 'Since November 2013, Namibia has been affected by a cholera outbreak, which was initially confined to four northern regions, including hardest-hit Kunene, as well as Omusati, Oshana and Ohangwena. By 10 Feb 2014, 504 cases and 16 deaths had been recorded. [ReliefWeb disaster page ep-2014-000025-nam; no per-region counts given for Omusati]' - cholera confirmed present; no case count available.
